_comment: Single source of truth for the submission metadata. These values were transcribed from the previously submitted LogInsight_Final_Project_Presentation.pptx and final-submission/FINAL_SUBMISSION_INDEX.md so that regenerating the documents cannot invent or drift them. They are NOT derived from source code and must be confirmed against the institution's records.
department: Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
project_subtitle: Algorithm-Driven Log Analysis and Incident Investigation

verification.label: Frontend unit tests
verification.note: vitest run — 72 across 20 files, single aggregate run

verification.label: Browser end-to-end
verification.note: Playwright — all routes, 2D/3D round trip, reduced motion

limitations: In-memory, single-current-dataset state. No database, no durable uploads, no restart persistence.
No authentication or authorization. This is not a shared multi-user service.
Dataset Replay is a bounded replay of the loaded dataset, not a live collector.
Live Monitor is server-generated simulation from a scenario and seed, not captured telemetry.
Topology edges are request-trail adjacency inferred from requestId co-occurrence, not verified infrastructure.
Benchmarks are host- and input-dependent measurements, not universal performance claims.
The 3D topology requires WebGL and falls back to 2D where it is unavailable.
Generated traffic is not production telemetry and is labelled as such throughout the interface.

algorithms.name: KMP
algorithms.role: Linear exact substring search; no backtracking.

algorithms.name: Aho-Corasick
algorithms.role: Every error signature matched in one left-to-right pass.

algorithms.name: Levenshtein / Damerau
algorithms.role: Edit-distance DP ranks a 'did you mean' suggestion.

algorithms.name: BFS over dependency graph
algorithms.role: Blast radius reachable downstream of the failing service.

algorithms.name: Fixed-window detection
algorithms.role: Bucketed, baseline-relative threshold, merged into one window.

algorithms.name: Suffix array + Kasai LCP
algorithms.role: Traceable phrase search over the corpus.
